written_before: any DEV-20 score of the arms below was computed (the DEV control fidelity re-derivation preceded it)
mechanism: JERSEY NAME-BORROWING: an unnamed track copies the jersey number of a named track that is plausibly the same person. Propagation only -- no track is merged, no track_id changes, so GS-AssA is untouched by construction.

harness_fidelity.verdict: all three registered rows reproduced to 4 dp on 2026-08-15; per-sequence row counts are the shipped-submission lineage, NOT the drifted eval_v4 cache of kb v9-w1-006

candidate_set.generator: tools.gsr_v9_factory.build_pairs with FactoryParams() (ordered pairs, A ends before B starts, gap <= 750 frames, endpoint distance closable at 9 m/s + 2 m slack), run on tracklets summarised from the CONTROL-STATE submission JSON itself (tools.gsr_v9_w6.submission_rows)
hard_filters: exactly one side carries a jersey number (nothing to borrow otherwise; the jersey-conflict guard is inapplicable when one side is silent)

BOTH sides are player-majority -- goalkeeper- and referee-majority tracks are excluded on both sides, because GT numbers neither (v8-W3: 0/156 GKs numbered), so any borrow touching one can only over-name
both sides carry a known team side and the same one
candidate_set.why_hard_filters_are_correct_here: this is a COPY, not a merge. W1's features-not-filters finding (kb v9-w1-004) is about merges, where a wrong gate destroys a trajectory; a refused copy costs only the copy.
candidate_set.one_borrow_rule: each unnamed track takes the number of its single best-scoring named partner above threshold; a named track may lend to several borrowers, each on its own evidence. Ties break on the smaller lender id, so the plan is order-independent.

twix.aggregation: SEED-ENSEMBLE MEAN LOGIT over the three seeds -- chosen a priori; the s0-only spread is reported as robustness information, not as an arm
twix.clip_channel: FORCED MISSING on both train and DEV. The DEV detection-embedding cache joins the shipped submission on only 790/896 tracks and is broken on 11 of 20 sequences (kb v9-w1-006 / v9-w5-002), so the appearance channel cannot be used reproducibly there; switching it off on the calibration side too makes application and calibration see identical features.

phys.score: -req_speed_mps (the speed the endpoint gap would demand)

train_calibration.split: GSR-TRAIN, 57 sequences, the W1 pair dataset outputs/gsr/v9_assoc/v1 (DEV-20, TEST-38, test-49 and challenge untouched)

census_unnamed_player_tracklets.danger_zone: 24.2% of the GT-resolvable unnamed player tracklets (484/1998), and 33.1% of their rows (79,144/239,107), belong to identities GT leaves UNNUMBERED -- naming any of those rows destroys a null==null match. That is the over-naming cost a blind borrow would pay.

train_calibration.outcome_labels: correct = borrowed number equals the GT number of the borrower's dominant GT identity; neutral = that identity IS numbered but we copied a different number (DetA-neutral: a wrong number scores exactly what null scores); overnamed = the identity is UNNUMBERED (a real loss); unknown = the tracklet has no trusted GT identity.
train_calibration.threshold_rule: the grid threshold that MAXIMISES net rows (rows_correct - rows_overnamed) on GSR-TRAIN subject to overname_share_of_touched <= 0.15 (a margin under the registered 20% gate). Fixed before the curves were read; applied mechanically to both arms.

twix_curve_selected.runner_up: threshold -3.0 has a larger reach (1,540 tracks / 47,026 rows) but 16.1% over-naming, above the 0.15 admissibility cap; its net (10,981) is also lower.

phys_curve.verdict: NO ADMISSIBLE OPERATING POINT. Over the whole registered grid (req_speed 0.5 ... 9.0 m/s) the over-naming share never falls below 17.7% and the net rows are NEGATIVE at every threshold (best -25 rows at req_speed <= 0.5 m/s). Physics alone cannot tell a fragment of the same player from a different player of the same team.
phys_curve.disposition: scored on DEV-20 at its least-bad point (-0.5, i.e. req_speed <= 0.5 m/s) as a NEGATIVE CONTROL that measures what the learned ranking is actually buying -- it is not a shipping candidate.

arms.name: phys
arms.role: negative control; failed its own train-side admissibility rule

gates.hota: pooled GS-HOTA not worse than the control
gates.paired: per-sequence GS-HOTA helped > hurt with Wilcoxon p < 0.05 (n = 20)
gates.row_audit: every changed row classified newly-correct / newly-wrong-named / over-named / unmatched; over-naming must be < 20% of touched rows

noise_floor: exactly 0 -- the checkpoints are frozen and every step is a deterministic pure function of the submission JSON. Ensemble-vs-s0 spread is reported as robustness information.
composition: a new post-processing step AFTER vote_track_attributes AND AFTER gk_side_repair. Order matters twice: (1) the borrow reads the FINAL role labels, so a track gk_side promoted to goalkeeper is excluded from both sides of a borrow; (2) a borrowed number is written to every row of the borrowing track at once, so the result is already vote-consistent and needs no re-vote. Ships default OFF.
splits: DEV-20 only; TEST-38, test-49 and challenge are not read in this session
